_about: Walter White (CASE-045). A former chemistry teacher who runs a car wash on the side, settles what he can in cash and prefers as little in writing as possible. His book is 63% health care and 41% Novartis alone. Every question was checked against POST /ask first.

lines.text: Morning, it's Walter. Quick one before my first lesson. How much did today cost me?
I still follow the chemistry side. How much of my portfolio is in pharma?
Hm. Am I too concentrated in one thing?
And how has it done over the year?
How risky is the portfolio overall?
Right. And how much cash do I have with you?
When did we last actually change anything?
Good. Keep it off paper where you can. I'll call you.
